checks.note: In the source, 'to my knowledge' qualifies only the testing clause. The first clause, 'Strictly speaking Tesla doesn't even build driverless cars', is a flat assertion. The proposition puts 'As far as Marcus knows' over both clauses, which understates what he committed to on building. The rationale, dates (Oct 4/6 2023; Feb 26 2026), the six-year California record, the citations and the unresolved outcome all match the evidence and the agreed assessment.

The public evidence excerpts are cut to the fragments '68% lower' and '81%'. The recorded exact words are full sentences ('...police-reportable crash involvement rates 68% lower than human drivers in the same areas and years'; '...85% fewer single-vehicle crashes and 81% fewer injury crashes per VMT'). Without them, a reader cannot tell what each figure measures. The rationale (study published July 23 2026, 2021–2024, ~50M miles, Austin 4% higher), the proposition and the supported/conclusive_event outcome are otherwise accurate.
